content: {"like": ["Excellent subtitles that accurately display speaker names and follow the speaker’s face or chest, making it easy to read and almost entertaining.", "Subtitles are not limited to the bottom of the screen and can show entire sentences at once, improving readability during fast‑paced dialogue.", "The ability to rewind and pause to catch missed bits, which is helpful for complex scenes.", "Indispensable for watching British shows on disc, providing clear dialogue and context.", "Season three’s BD treatment is considered the best among the seasons."], "dislike": ["One mistake where the subtitle appeared on Major West’s face while Robinson was speaking, indicating occasional errors.", "Subtitles or CC can be pretty poor or completely wrong at times, which can be frustrating.", "Commentary is not available for every episode, limiting the viewing experience compared to other series."]}
